Koegaki 1.3.0

  • New: Cleanup. Choose Clean in Settings and English dictations are tidied before they are inserted: filler words, stutters and false starts go, punctuation and capitalization are fixed. A small language model runs on your Mac (about 1.7 GB, downloaded once when you turn it on). Nothing you say leaves your machine.
  • Every cleanup is checked against your words before anything is inserted: a dropped negation, a changed number, an invented sentence or added formatting sends your raw transcription through instead.
  • Cleanup adds a short pause before each insertion, usually well under a second on recent Macs and up to a couple of seconds on older Macs or long utterances. If the model cannot keep up three times in a row, Koegaki pauses cleanup and tells you. Off restores instant insertion.
